Row.Text: The child cries for nine days without ceasing. On the ninth day, she stops. The next day, the rains begin. The next kumari is chosen – a link between the world of the gods and the world of humanity.
Keeping Nepalese traditions alive should be a priority, no matter how much Nepal modernizes.
Such practices are cultural heritage, not a basis for politics.

The expansion of Nepali society has not been without cost. A new measure to bring some form of standard governance to its increasingly diverse cities has led to a sustained protest from religious leaders - no state rites, no state rituals, until religious law is recognized as the basis for secular law.
Allow priests and holy men a hand in drafting a new code.
